items.title: Support per-metric internal telemetry level configuration
items.body:
### Component(s)

service

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

The Collector only lets set one global internal metrics level with `service::telemetry::metrics::level`.

That provides too much information. Sometimes I want to keep the Collector at `normal`, but enable one detailed metric or one set of detailed-only attributes.

Examples:
- `otelcol_exporter_queue_batch_send_size_bytes`
- `error.type` / `error.permanent` on `otelcol_exporter_send_failed_*` introduced as part of https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/issues/13956
- `otelcol_*_compressed_size` if I'm not mistaken

### Describe the solution you'd like

Not sure what would be the best solution for this.

### Describe alternatives you've considered

There is a workaround today: set `service::telemetry::metrics::level: detailed` and then use `service::telemetry::metrics::views` to drop the extra metrics.

That is not great because:
- `views` are only allowed when the global level is already `detailed`
- custom `views` replace the default views, so users have to manually recreate the current default filtering
- it solves this indirectly, but the actual need is "keep `normal`, opt in a few detailed metrics or extra attributes"

### Additional context

I recently got some feedback from users about this not being good UX.
